title: Arquiteto de Dados - Remoto
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de Dados - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Conhecimentos:

• Programação;

• Tratamento de Dados.

Linguagens:

• Python;

• PySpark;

• SQL.

Ferramentas:

Big Data:

• HUE;

• Hive;

• Spark (SparkML);

• NIFI.

Banco de Dados:

• DB2;

• MySQL;

• Oracle;

• Dbeaver (Ferramenta de Consulta).

• Modelagem de Dados (Erwin)

• Versionamento de código (Git)


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Pesquisador foco LC-MS
description:
#TEMOSVAGAS #LABPHARMA


Temos uma oportunidade aberta para Pesquisador com ênfase em identificação estrutural por LC/MS aqui no nosso #TIME.


A Labpharma Consultoria é uma empresa que tem por objetivo quebrar paradigmas e instalar novos conceitos na área de consultoria analítica e regulatória através do fornecimento de um serviço diferenciado e inovador, com foco na Indústria Farmacêutica, estabelecendo relações de confiança e parceria com os clientes


Buscamos Profissionais que tenham sinergia com os NOSSOS VALORES:

  • Perfil inovador, proativo, ágil e a com mente aberta para o aprendizado contínuo;
  • Capacidade analítica para solução de problemas, alta capacidade de cultivar a proximidade com o cliente;
  • Senso de pertencimento;
  • Capacidade analítica e estatística;
  • Iniciativa e motivação em um ambiente com atividades desafiadoras frequentes, que exigem tomadas de decisões rápidas e eficientes;
  • Comprometimento com prazos, qualidade e transparência através de relacionamento baseado na confiança, integridade, respeito, ética e credibilidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Orientar e suportar a equipe, sendo o focal point para reporte dos resultados, status dos projetos e rotina do laboratório, a gestão.
  • Exercer papel de liderança gerindo conflitos e auxiliando em tomadas de decisões.
  • Realizar Estudos de extraíveis e lixiviáveis de acordo com as recomendações do PQRI e monografias como USP <1663> e <1664>;
  • Realizar identificação e caracterização de impurezas químicas através de técnicas analíticas, como HPLC-DAD, LC-MS e GC-MS;
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas com clientes, sobre os estudos em andamento;
  • Imprescindível conhecimento em elucidação estrutural;
  • Imprescindível experiência em Espectrometria de Massas (LC-MS);
  • Conhecimento nas legislações nacionais (Anvisa) e internacionais (FDA, EMA, PDA, entre outros);
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas com clientes, sobre os estudos em andamento;


Habilidades: Fluidez de comunicação, facilidade de relacionamento, atitude positiva e dinâmica, ser resiliente, apresentar segurança, ter empatia, e capacidade de inspirar confiança.


Competências:

· Pesquisa e desenvolvimento (P&D)

· Boas práticas de laboratório

· Procedimento operacional padrão (POP)

· Microsoft Office

· Trabalho em equipe

· Planejamento estratégico

· Técnicas de laboratório

· Desenvolvimento de método

· Gestão Técnicas de laboratório

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatório: Curso superior completo em farmácia, química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas.

Diferencial: Pós-graduação nas áreas relacionadas;


Salário: A Combinar

Modalidade: 100% Presencial.

Localidade: Alphaville, Santana De Parnaíba.

#TEMOSVAGAS #LABPHARMA


Temos uma oportunidade aberta para Pesquisador com ênfase em identificação estrutural por LC/MS aqui no nosso #TIME.


A Labpharma Consultoria é uma empresa que tem por objetivo quebrar paradigmas e instalar novos conceitos na área de consultoria analítica e regulatória através do fornecimento de um serviço diferenciado e inovador, com foco na Indústria Farmacêutica, estabelecendo relações de confiança e parceria com os clientes


Buscamos Profissionais que tenham sinergia com os NOSSOS VALORES:

  • Perfil inovador, proativo, ágil e a com mente aberta para o aprendizado contínuo;
  • Capacidade analítica para solução de problemas, alta capacidade de cultivar a proximidade com o cliente;
  • Senso de pertencimento;
  • Capacidade analítica e estatística;
  • Iniciativa e motivação em um ambiente com atividades desafiadoras frequentes, que exigem tomadas de decisões rápidas e eficientes;
  • Comprometimento com prazos, qualidade e transparência através de relacionamento baseado na confiança, integridade, respeito, ética e credibilidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Orientar e suportar a equipe, sendo o focal point para reporte dos resultados, status dos projetos e rotina do laboratório, a gestão.
  • Exercer papel de liderança gerindo conflitos e auxiliando em tomadas de decisões.
  • Realizar Estudos de extraíveis e lixiviáveis de acordo com as recomendações do PQRI e monografias como USP <1663> e <1664>;
  • Realizar identificação e caracterização de impurezas químicas através de técnicas analíticas, como HPLC-DAD, LC-MS e GC-MS;
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas com clientes, sobre os estudos em andamento;
  • Imprescindível conhecimento em elucidação estrutural;
  • Imprescindível experiência em Espectrometria de Massas (LC-MS);
  • Conhecimento nas legislações nacionais (Anvisa) e internacionais (FDA, EMA, PDA, entre outros);
  • Conduzir discussões técnicas com clientes, sobre os estudos em andamento;


Habilidades: Fluidez de comunicação, facilidade de relacionamento, atitude positiva e dinâmica, ser resiliente, apresentar segurança, ter empatia, e capacidade de inspirar confiança.


Competências:

· Pesquisa e desenvolvimento (P&D)

· Boas práticas de laboratório

· Procedimento operacional padrão (POP)

· Microsoft Office

· Trabalho em equipe

· Planejamento estratégico

· Técnicas de laboratório

· Desenvolvimento de método

· Gestão Técnicas de laboratório

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatório: Curso superior completo em farmácia, química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas.

Diferencial: Pós-graduação nas áreas relacionadas;


Salário: A Combinar

Modalidade: 100% Presencial.

Localidade: Alphaville, Santana De Parnaíba.

title: Data Specialist
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


About the Role:

We currently have 90+ Data team members who create and maintain our data products and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply.

At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. While nearly everyone enters the Data Specialist position at the same level, starting compensation is based on years of relevant experience. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with frequent opportunities to grow compensation and achieve promotions.

See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!


In this role, you will:

  • Be the primary owner of high-impact work such as running or building new data products end-to-end, running centralized data ingestion pipelines that the broader Data team relies on, or building clean granular data feeds that help clients dive into data.
  • Work with massive amounts of data to help answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and the datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
  • Become a trusted and reliable resource for our internal stakeholders or clients and work with them to identify and answer their key questions. You’ll gain insight into how investors use data in their investment decisions by contributing to data feeds, custom analysis, or data reports that are consumed by the top investors in the world. If you join one of our Central Data teams, you’ll also learn how our data drives decision-making at some of the largest companies in the world.
  • Improve our products, data pipelines, or data feeds by developing entirely new methodologies and features for our products, exploring and scaling use across the data team of new third-party datasets, or creating new modules to make our raw feeds data experience better. We value self-improvement and experimentation and expect you to enhance the products, pipelines, or data feeds that you own.
  • Learn or sharpen existing SQL and Python skills starting with our two-month new hire training program that will teach you SQL, PySpark, and Python fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have a strong ownership mentality and want to ensure our products are the best in the world
  • You have strong attention to detail
  • You are a methodical problem-solver
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts, both orally and in writing
  • You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible
  • You have an ability to manage multiple priorities
  • You are experimental and curious – you aren’t afraid of changing the status quo
  • You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.


For You:

  • You’ll work with a New York-based team
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Consultor SAP EHS Sênior
description:
Consultor EHS Sênior

Modelo de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado

Tempo de Alocação: Previsão de 3 meses

Atuação 100% remoto


Principais responsabilidades:

• Atuar como referência técnica e funcional em sap eh&s em projetos de implementação, migração, upgrade e rollout do sap s/4 hana.

• Conduzir e suportar rollouts internacionais/globais, assegurando padronização, compliance regulatório e alinhamento com o template global.

• Configurar, manter e otimizar processos de eh&s, incluindo gestão de produtos perigosos e fichas de segurança.

• Garantir a correta aplicação das regulamentações governamentais e requisitos legais relacionados a segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.

• Apoiar testes integrados, validações funcionais e entrada em produção, garantindo qualidade e estabilidade das soluções.

• Atuar de forma colaborativa com times de negócio, tecnologia e stakeholders globais.


Requisitos:

• Experiência comprovada como Consultor(a) SAP EHS.

• Inglês Avançado.

• Vivência em projetos de implementação, migração, upgrade e rollout no ambiente sap s/4 hana.

• Experiência em projetos de rollout internacional ou global.

• Domínio técnico dos cenários sap eh&s, incluindo:

– 3fc: evaluate dangerous goods for a product;

– 3g8: dangerous goods in the value chain;

– 3vr: managing safety data sheets for products;

– 3vq: safety data sheets in the value chain.


Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Vendedor
description:
A Carli Mídias está em busca de um(a) Vendedor(a) com perfil consultivo e foco total em resultados para se juntar ao nosso time comercial. Atuamos 100% remotamente, oferecendo soluções de tráfego pago com metodologia baseada em performance que geram crescimento real para nossos clientes.


Você será responsável por prospectar, qualificar e nutrir leads, garantindo um fluxo saudável no funil de vendas da agência. Esta é a oportunidade ideal para quem busca autonomia, comissões atrativas e um ambiente com mentalidade de alta performance.


RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Realizar prospecção ativa (outbound) e atendimento a leads qualificados (inbound) visando agendar reuniões qualificadas;
  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico para levantamento de necessidades;
  • Manter nosso CRM atualizado com histórico de interações e status do funil de vendas;
  • Executar follow-ups estratégicos para aumentar a taxa de conversão;
  • Acompanhar metas semanais e mensais com indicadores de performance comercial;
  • Participar de treinamentos e alinhamentos com o time.


REQUISITOS
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas, preferencialmente de serviços digitais ou marketing;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Organização e disciplina para atuar em home office;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre tráfego pago (Google Ads, Meta Ads, etc.);
  • Habilidade com ferramentas como CRM, Google Workspace e plataformas de reuniões online;
  • Perfil orientado a metas, com foco em resultado e autonomia.


DESEJÁVEL, MAS NÃO ELIMINATÓRIO
  • Certificações ou cursos de vendas;
  • Experiência com vendas B2B ou serviços para empresas de pequeno e médio porte;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias como SPIN Selling;
  • Vivência com funis de vendas e abordagens de inbound e outbound.


PERFIL COMPORTAMENTAL
  • Proatividade;
  • Foco em metas e crescimento financeiro;
  • Capacidade de escuta ativa e argumentação estratégica;
  • Organização e autogestão no ambiente remoto;
  • Resiliência e persistência em processos de negociação;
  • Vontade de aprender, evoluir e crescer junto com a empresa.


CONTRATO E REMUNERAÇÃO
  • Contrato PJ;

Remuneração FIXO + Comissão + Bonificações por meta batida.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

description:
Assistente de Auditoria - Filial Campo Grande


Estamos com uma oportunidade de trabalho na BDO , 1º M&A Advisor globalmente (Pitchbook, 2020), 1º Deal Advisors & Accountants globalmente (Pitchbook), 2°Due Diligence Advisor globalmente (Mergermarket), 3º Due Diligence Advisor na América do Sul (Mergermarket) e 5ª maior empresa de consultoria e auditoria do mundo, presente em 167 países. Temos foco em middle-market e uma equipe de 2.000+ profissionais no Brasil e 91 mil+ no mundo.


O que buscamos em você:

  • Conhecimento em auditoria externa;

  • Necessária disponibilidade para viagens;
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Word, Excel e Power Point;

Na BDO você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Desempenhar trabalhos de campo, colhendo informações necessárias para o planejamento e desenvolvimento dos projetos;
  • Executar, procedimentos de auditoria previstos no planejamento dos projetos em que estiver alocado, atendendo às normas de auditoria, e prazos estabelecidos;
  • Elaborar planilhas e relatórios técnicos para informar os resultados às áreas interessadas;
  • Posicionar constantemente os responsáveis do cliente quanto ao andamento do trabalho.


O que oferecemos:

  • Assistência odontológica (SulAmérica)
  • Vale-transporte;

  • Auxílio academia TotalPass
  • Seguro de vida;

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Remote)
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer


We are looking for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, maintaining, and improving our infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, observability stack, and platform operations. You will work closely with development, security, and operations teams to ensure reliable delivery, stability, and scalability of our systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI.
  • Manage and evolve our GitOps workflows using FluxCD for Kubernetes deployments.
  • Maintain and enhance our Kubernetes clusters, ensuring reliability, security and scalability.
  • Develop automation tools and services using Python.
  • Manage and support a wide range of open-source services.
  • Administer and secure secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimise platform performance and reliability.
  • Work across teams to enhance observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks.
  • Manage and maintain Linux-based environments and infrastructure.
  • Perform basic network troubleshooting and support connectivity-related issues.
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and automation-first culture.


Core Technical Skills

  • Proven track record with GitLab CI for CI/CD pipeline creation and maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with GitOps tooling, ideally FluxCD.
  • Solid understanding and operational experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Scripting experience with Python.
  • Experience with open-source services such as, Elastic stack, Prometheus & Alertmanager, Fluentd, Kafka, Consul.
  • Experience with Hashicorp Vault (policies, secrets engines, authentication methods).
  • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes and container lifecycle management.
  • Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues (DNS, routing, firewall basics, TCP/IP) would be a positive.

title: Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional
description:
A SWM International é uma multinacional produtora de papéis para indústria do tabaco e soluções em papéis especiais.


Somos fabricantes especializados de uma variedade de materiais avançados, presentes no dia a dia das pessoas. Nós fazemos parte do seu dia com nossos produtos de qualidade e colaboramos com nossos clientes para fornecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas para aumentar o valor de seus produtos.


Agora, queremos convidar você a fazer parte do nosso dia a dia, onde cada colaborador é essencial para o sucesso da nossa empresa.

Traga o seu talento para a SWM!


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Processos e Excelência Operacional para atuar em uma posição permanente na nossa Unidade em Piraí, no Rio de Janeiro.


Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Gestão da rotina operacional:

Garantir a execução dos padrões operacionais

Acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs)

Conduzir reuniões de performance e atuar sobre desvios


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento de equipe:

Direcionar atividades, desenvolver competências e acompanhar resultados

Estimular a cultura de melhoria contínua e excelência operacional


  • Gestão de processos e projetos:

Mapear, padronizar e otimizar processos (BPMN, POPs, KPIs)

Liderar projetos Lean, Kaizen e iniciativas de melhoria contínua

Sustentar a governança dos processos operacionais


  • Controle de custos e eficiência:

Analisar consumos, perdas e desperdícios

Definir e acompanhar ações de redução de custos

Validar ganhos e apoiar o orçamento com dados de produtividade


Requisitos Mínimos:

  • Formação acadêmica

Superior completo em Engenharia Química ou áreas afins

Desejável pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos ou Gestão de Negócios


  • Experiência profissional

Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em ambiente industrial

Vivência em processos e/ou produção, preferencialmente na indústria de Papel e Celulose

Experiência com excelência operacional e melhoria contínua


  • Conhecimentos técnicos

Processos industriais e funcionamento de máquinas de papel

Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S, FMEA, Ishikawa, CEP)

Certificação Green Belt ou Black Belt (desejável)

Gestão de Processos (BPMN, POPs, KPIs, análise de gargalos)

Gestão de Projetos (PMBOK, Agile, gestão de riscos e stakeholders)

Análise de dados e sistemas: Power BI, DCS/QCS, MES, ERP (ex.: SAP)

Normas de Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001)


  • Idiomas

Inglês: avançado

Espanhol: Intermediário


  • O que temos para você:

Salário atrativo conforme mercado


Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde: SUL AMÉRICA – Familiar – sem coparticipação - Abrangência nacional (titular mensal gratuito)
  • Assistência Oftalmológica: Reembolso de até R$ 517,00 (armações e lentes) por ano.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo: Seguro Sul América, com participação mensal do funcionário por meio de desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Plano Odontológico: Amil 700, familiar, com abrangência nacional.

title: Analista Desenvolvedor Dynamics 365
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Remoto | Horário Comercial | CLT


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, configurar e otimizar processos e fluxos de trabalho nos módulos do Dynamics 365 .
  • Criar, customizar e implementar soluções dentro do ambiente Dynamics 365.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das soluções, realizando melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas como vendas, atendimento, CX e produtos para integração das soluções.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Dynamics 365 , incluindo configuração e gestão de soluções.
  • Experiência em C# .
  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando graduação na área de Tecnologia.


Habilidades desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em HTML e JavaScript .
  • Boa lógica de programação.
  • Capacidade de identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de negócio.



Benefícios:

✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

title: Junior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Java Developer to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics, and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure the code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.


Does this sounds like something you'd like to do? Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here.

title: Field Support Engineer
description:
Location: Brazil | Supporting CALA

Company : Intellicene

Here’s the thing - This role sits right between deep technical work and real customer ownership. You’ll be hands-on with Intellicene’s software and hardware in the field, while also acting as a trusted advisor to customers across the CALA region.

What you’ll do

• Install, upgrade, troubleshoot, and maintain Intellicene’s enterprise software and related hardware

• Support video management, situational awareness, and dispatch solutions — onsite and remotely

• Own technical issues end-to-end and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them fast

• Travel to customer sites (up to 75%) for project deployment and delivering hands-on training

• Manage the customer lifecycle from onboarding to long-term success

• Drive product adoption through training, usage analysis, and practical guidance

• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives

• Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and work closely with Sales

What you bring

• Fluent Portuguese, Spanish, and English

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience

• Experience in physical security/video surveillance environments

• Strong background supporting enterprise software in LAN/WAN environments

• Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Multicast)

• Experience with Windows Server, virtualization, MS SQL Server, and hardware (RAID, NAS/SAN)

• Customer-facing mindset with clear communication and presentation skills

• Experience with tools like Salesforce, Zoho, Aha, and Microsoft 365

• Willingness to travel frequently and handle shifting priorities

Nice to have

• 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, professional services, pre/post-sales)

• Relevant certifications (Cisco, MCSE, Project Management)

• Experience reading SOWs and presenting to executive audiences

If you enjoy being close to the technology and even closer to the customer, this role is for you.

Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer to augment the existing team and help accelerate delivery of a critical platform rewrite. This role will play a key part in shaping, building, and stabilizing a new integrated Salesforce-based platform, working closely with internal stakeholders and external partner teams.


Role Overview

The Senior Salesforce Developer will work alongside our partner teams, contributing hands-on to the design and development of the new integrated platform. This is a full-stack Salesforce role, with a strong emphasis on backend development, system integrations, and data modeling, as well as selective frontend work following established UI patterns and standards.


In this role, they will be expected to take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical decision-making, and uphold engineering best practices across a distributed development environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Salesforce backend components (Apex classes, triggers, batch jobs, async processing) aligned with the ongoing platform rewrite.
  • Contribute to Salesforce architecture decisions, including data modeling, integration patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Implement front-end functionality (LWC / Aura) by following existing design systems, UX patterns, and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and event-driven patterns where applicable.
  • Collaborate closely with distributed teams, including India-based Salesforce developers and the Brazil-based Astra team, ensuring alignment and consistent delivery.
  • Perform code reviews, mentor less-experienced developers, and promote best practices across the codebase.
  • Ensure solutions meet high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Participate in our partner’s technical vetting, documentation, and formal code review processes.
  • Proactively identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement during the rewrite effort.


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience with deep expertise in Apex, triggers, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce platform limits, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
  • Experience building and maintaining Lightning Web Components (LWC) and working within established front-end frameworks.
  • Proven experience working on complex, large-scale Salesforce implementations or platform rewrites.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms and migration initiatives (GCP preferred, but AWS/Azure acceptable).
  • Experience working in distributed or staff-augmentation teams, collaborating across time zones and cultures.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Nearshore location preferred (Brazil, Mexico, Costa Rica) to ensure time-zone alignment.
  • Ability to successfully pass a full technical interview and live coding assessment.


Nice to Have:

  • Exposure to Flutter or Go, which may be relevant for future product initiatives.
  • Experience with video/audio streaming applications or real-time collaboration platforms.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Salesforce DevOps tooling.
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architecture Designer) are a plus.


Why Join:

  • Work on a high-impact, end-to-end platform rewrite with a clearly defined launch timeline.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers and technical leaders in a distributed, cross-functional environment.
  • Opportunity to influence architecture and engineering practices on a mission-critical system.
  • Fully remote, nearshore-friendly role with potential for long-term engagement and growth.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work on a high-impact, mission-critical platform alongside senior engineers in a fully remote, collaborative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Você será parte de uma equipe de alta performance focada em garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura em nuvem global da empresa, com foco em Microsoft Azure . Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, com equilíbrio entre projetos estratégicos em sprints quinzenais e suporte contínuo à infraestrutura produtiva , garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas críticos.

Se você é apaixonado por automação, observabilidade, arquitetura em nuvem e tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura como código, esta é uma oportunidade para impactar diretamente na transformação digital de grandes clientes do mercado.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar, analisar e otimizar o desempenho da infraestrutura em Microsoft Azure (clusters, redes, serviços de dados e aplicações).
  • Desenvolver, manter e escalar infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambientes multi-região.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions , garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.
  • Atuar no ciclo de incidentes em produção , incluindo triagem, análise de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis), documentação e implementação de correções preventivas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para otimizar arquiteturas em nuvem , promovendo melhores práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e custo.
  • Administrar e monitorar serviços críticos como Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway e redes privadas (VNet, ExpressRoute) .
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog , criando dashboards personalizados, alertas e métricas para clusters e serviços em Azure.
  • Apoiar a gestão de dados em Databricks , garantindo integridade, performance e segurança dos pipelines de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway, Networking).
  • Proficiência em Terraform para provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD usando Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions .
  • Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade com Datadog (criação de dashboards, alertas, monitoramento de clusters).
  • Experiência com Databricks e processos de data engineering em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ciclo de incidentes com foco em resolução rápida e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (leitura, escrita e comunicação oral) – necessário para colaboração com times globais.


Benefícios e Cultura

  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com foco em crescimento profissional.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e trabalho remoto.
  • Programa de capacitação contínua (cursos, certificações, eventos).
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos com impacto real no negócio.
  • Integração com o Mantu Group , rede de empresas de tecnologia e consultoria com presença global.

title: ESTÁGIO | Contábil - [1 vaga]
description:
Estágio em Contabilidade (Foco Contábil) | ATCOS (Grupo Stegia)


VAGA REMOTA | GOIÂNIA - GO


A Stegia está conduzindo o processo seletivo para a ATCOS , empresa do nosso grupo.

Buscamos um estagiário(a) para atuar especificamente na área de Contabilidade , em um ambiente altamente colaborativo e estimulante. Se você deseja aprender a fundo sobre fechamentos, análises de balanços e quer entender como a saúde financeira das empresas é construída, essa vaga é para você!


Valorizamos a transparência, a inovação e a iniciativa. Aqui, o trabalho em equipe é diário e você será incentivado a participar ativamente de projetos e rotinas contábeis, sempre com foco em soluções de qualidade e aprendizado contínuo.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):

  • Formação: Cursando Ciências Contábeis (preferencialmente a partir do 4º período).
  • Perfil: Movido por desafios, com perfil analítico e muita vontade de aprender.
  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento básico no Pacote Google (especialmente Google Sheets).
  • Diferenciais: Conhecimento prévio no sistema Domínio e noção sobre a estrutura de Balanços e DRE.
  • Habilidades: Boa comunicação, atenção a detalhes e organização.


Suas responsabilidades (Com suporte e supervisão):

  • Auxiliar na análise e registro de lançamentos contábeis;
  • Suporte no processo de fechamento contábil mensal;
  • Apoio na elaboração de relatórios financeiros (Balanços, DRE e demonstrações);
  • Auxílio na gestão e entrega de obrigações acessórias contábeis;
  • Suporte ao time operacional e no atendimento ao cliente externo.


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente Dinâmico: Ritmo acelerado com aprendizado prático constante;
  • Cultura Empreendedora: Chance de trabalhar ao lado de profissionais experientes e mentores;
  • Ferramentas: Todo o suporte e sistemas necessários para seu desenvolvimento;
  • Benefícios: Day-Off no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Bolsa Auxílio: Valor será apresentado durante a seleção.


Treinamentos Inclusos:

  • Integração com as políticas e cultura do Grupo;
  • Treinamento técnico sobre as rotinas e responsabilidades do setor contábil;
  • Capacitação nos sistemas de gestão e rotinas-chave da ATCOS.

title: SASE Network Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


Job Title: Senior SASE Network Engineer

Location: Latham

Duration: 1+ Year


Role Description:

The Senior Network Engineer, SASE will serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for all SASE-related technologies, driving the network and security transformation from traditional, perimeter-based models to a secure, cloud-centric architecture. This role involves integrating core SASE components—such as SD-WAN, Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)—to deliver secure and high-performance access for all users, regardless of location. Join us to tackle challenging projects and make a direct impact on our core product while investing in your professional growth.


This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be located in Bengaluru, India. At Client, our vision is to be the leading provider of seamlessly connected diagnostic solutions.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Design and Architect highly available, scalable, and secure SASE solutions for complex, global, and hybrid-cloud network environments.
  • Lead the implementation and deployment of core SASE components, including SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, Firewall-as-a-Service (FWaaS), and DNS security solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and optimize security policies, routing, and traffic steering logic across the SASE platform to enforce a consistent security posture.
  • Evaluate and integrate new SASE-related technologies and features to maintain a state-of-the-art security and networking stack.
  • Drive Zero Trust principles by designing and implementing fine-grained, identity-centric access control policies (ZTNA).
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities using scripting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools to increase deployment speed and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Cyber Security teams to ensure SASE policies and configurations align with organizational security standards and compliance requirements (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, ISO).


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in network and/or security engineering, with at least 2 years focused on SASE or similar cloud security architectures.
  • Expert knowledge of SASE Framework and its core components (SD-WAN, ZTNA, CASB, SWG, FWaaS).
  • Extensive hands-on experience with major SASE vendor solutions (e.g., Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks Prisma Access, Fortinet, Cisco/Meraki).
  • Deep understanding of Network Protocols including TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, and IPsec VPNs.
  • Proficiency in Cloud Networking and security principles in one or more major public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong Scripting and Automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Terraform, Ansible) for infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • Familiarity with Network Security concepts such as Next-Generation Firewalls, IDS/IPS, TLS inspection, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)



Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-15% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Python, YAML
  • Jira, Confluence
  • Ansible automation

  • Desenvolver programação do início ao fim, incluindo definições de arquitetura, testes e rollout em produção;

  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento de consumidores e produtores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka) ;

  • Continuous Delivery.

title: Consultor de investimentos
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcio do Brasil. Nossa maior missão é ajudar os clientes com soluções financeiras para realização de seus projetos pessoais ou profissionais. Estamos em busca de novos talentos, para fazer parte de uma empresa de apaixonados pelo que fazem!


Sobre o Cargo:

Se você gosta da área comercial, mas ainda não achou o produto ideal que lhe dê o devido retorno financeiro, venha conhecer a nossa empresa! Que vem realizando o sonho de muitos consultores também! Caso você ainda não tenha experiência, mas tenha os requisitos abaixo, também temos oportunidade pra você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Ambição para ter uma vida extraordinária;
  • Perfil com energia empreendedora, proativo;
  • Disposição para aprendizado contínuo;
  • Vontade de trabalhar e colocar em prática todo o aprendizado.


Qualificações:

Plano de desenvolvimento do consultor e Universidade Corporativa Ademicon.


Habilidades Necessárias:

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes
  • Financial Management & Resource Optimization
  • Track project revenue performance and burn rate to ensure creative projects remain profitable and within approved budgets
  • Monitor creative resource allocation and make real-time adjustments to optimize team utilization and creative project efficiency
  • Collaborate with finance and operations teams to maintain accurate forecasting
  • Cross-Solution Integration & Creative Workflow Leadership
  • Maintain strategic awareness of creative project integration points across solution project management campaigns to ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints
  • Collaborate with other solution PMs and the Project Lead to coordinate creative asset development timelines and shared brand resource requirements
  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution
  • Participate in cross-functional planning sessions to align creative initiatives with broader client marketing and brand strategies
  • Advanced Workflow Management & Quality Assurance
  • Manage Asana workflows for creative project management, including approval processes, version control, and comprehensive asset management systems
  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes
  • Experience in project management methodologies with the ability to adapt approaches for diverse creative workflows and brand requirements
  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems
  • Understanding of creative project P&L management and creative budget forecasting to maintain fiscal responsibility and profitability
  • Knowledge of multimedia production, content strategy, and cross-channel creative campaign coordination
  • Experience with brand performance measurement, creative testing methodologies, and brand equity assessment tools
  • Proven ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining brand consistency, quality standards, and team accountability
  • Strong collaborator, skilled at aligning strategists and creative teams, fostering open communication between platforms and specialists
  • Dexterity and wherewithal to effectively deal with campaign pivots, platform changes, and continuous optimization requirements
  • Demonstrates initiative and autonomy, effectively managing priorities while utilizing guidance and support when appropriate
  • Experience or interest in using AI tools, with a willingness to learn how AI can impact and appropriately enhance the client experience
  • Due to the remote environment, effective communication and time management skills are required, as well as the ability to use/learn multiple technology platforms and switch between them on a regular basis
  • Physical requirement: Must be able to work at a computer for prolonged periods


Credentials and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, Project Management, or related field, or equivalent life/work experience
  • 3-5 years of project management experience with increasing responsibility, including a minimum of 2 years in creative project management
  • Demonstrated experience managing brand, creative, or multimedia projects in professional services or higher education environments
  • Higher education or creative agency experience strongly preferred
  • PMP, Agile, or equivalent project management certification preferred


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Creative Project Manager
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose

The Creative Project Manager orchestrates strategic brand and creative initiatives that drive institutional brand equity and enrollment outcomes while maintaining fiscal responsibility for project profitability and creative team accountability. This role combines project management expertise with creative strategy understanding to deliver compelling, measurable brand solutions within the higher education space and consistency across creative deliverables provided by Carnegie.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Strategic Project Leadership & Brand Outcome Management
  • Lead comprehensive project planning for brand and creative initiatives, establishing clear milestone maps that connect creative deliverables to client brand and enrollment objectives
  • Coordinate Subject Matter Expert (SME) resourcing across creative, content, multimedia, and brand strategy teams to optimize creative outcomes in partnership with Client Operations
  • Proactively assess and mitigate creative project risks, including resource constraints, approval bottlenecks, and brand compliance challenges, escalating issues to the Project Lead or Account Director to ensure proactive resolution and sustained client retention
  • Hold creative teams accountable for brand adherence, quality standards, and deliverable excellence through structured review processes

  • Escalate creative integration challenges and brand compliance obstacles to Delivery Operations team for rapid resolution

  • Implement and uphold creative quality assurance standards that exceed client brand expectations and industry benchmarks
  • Develop comprehensive creative brief and project documentation systems that ensure stakeholder alignment and creative accountability
  • Facilitate strategic client communications regarding creative strategy, brand development progress, and creative campaign performance insights


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Understanding of brand strategy, visual identity systems, and creative campaign development to guide strategic creative approaches
  • Proficiency with creative workflow management, brand guideline implementation, and creative quality control processes

  • Advanced Asana administration, including creative-specific automation, approval workflows, and sophisticated asset management systems

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Arquiteto de Software em Cloud
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Projetar serviços utilizando a infraestrutura em cloud da AWS e Terraform;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento backend de uma solução web, utilizando Node.JS e Typescript;
  • Construir testes automatizados das soluções desenvolvidas com base em ferramentas existentes.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Engenharia/Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou similar;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento backend em Node.JS, typescript e frameworks (NESTJS);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento frontend em React;
  • Experiência na construção e implantação de arquiteturas baseadas em micros serviços;
  • Experiência em conteinerização (Docker) e ferramentas de orquestração (Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramente;
  • Experiência na criação de serviços e infraestrutura em cloud utilizando AWS;
  • Experiência no uso da ferramenta TerraForm;
  • Experiência com CI/CD com Jenkins; Git; etc.;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, leitura e escrita.

title: English Communty Leader Program (Remote)
description:
About Fondi

Fondi is a global English learning platform focused on conversation-based learning through live events and communities. We are looking for ESL tutors who want to go beyond teaching and grow their own English-speaking community.


Role description

As a Community Leader, you will build and grow an English learning community by hosting engaging events and guiding members to actively practice speaking in a supportive environment.


Responsibilities

  • Host English conversation events and community activities
  • Build and grow an active learner community
  • Create simple, engaging speaking activities
  • Guide trial members and support their learning journey
  • Work with the Fondi team to improve engagement and retention
  • Maintain consistency in hosting and community interaction


Incentives

  • Incentive-based earnings tied to activity and achievement
  • Rewards based on event consistency, community growth, and engagement
  • Opportunities to unlock higher incentives and VIP-level hosting
  • Personal brand exposure as a global community leader


Requirements

  • ESL tutor or English instructor of English Major Graduated welcome to apply
  • Confident spoken English
  • Comfortable hosting live sessions and leading discussions
  • Interest in community building and learner engagement
  • Reliable and proactive attitude

title: Desenvolvedor Drupal
description:
Mandatory Requirements:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven experience with Drupal 9/10/11 or readiness to transition to 11.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP , Twig , HTML5 , CSS3 , and JavaScript .
  • Experience with Drupal core/contrib upgrades and major version migrations.
  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with the Migrate API , Feeds , or other migration tools.
  • Familiarity with Drupal theming, custom module development, and site building.
  • Experience with Composer , Drush , and Git .
  • Strong knowledge of database management, particularly MySQL .
  • Ability to work with legacy systems and migrate them into a modern CMS framework.


Desirable Requirements:


  • Experience in automated testing frameworks for Drupal .
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Understanding of REST API integration.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure .
  • Knowledge of additional CMS platforms for broader technological insights.


Summary of Requirements: Drupal 9/10/11, PHP, Twig, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Migrate API, Feeds, Composer, Drush, Git, MySQL, REST API, AWS, Azure.

description:

  • Pesquisa de Usuário

  • Design de Aplicativos Mobile

Benefícios:


  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Programa de carreira
  • Treinamento remunerado
  • Folgas pagas
  • Férias no fim do ano
  • Encontro anual com empresa com tudo pago
  • PLR

  • Salário competitivo
