title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples that models might get wrong, and You would articulate the correct answer & explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills.
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Designer gráfico
description:
Somos uma agência em expansão, dinâmica e inovadora, comprometida em entregar soluções criativas e impactantes. Buscamos continuamente superar as expectativas de nossos clientes, oferecendo serviços de alta qualidade em design e comunicação visual.


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Designer Gráfico talentoso e motivado para se juntar à nossa equipe criativa. Nesta posição, você será responsável por desenvolver uma variedade de projetos gráficos, incluindo peças para mídias sociais, materiais de branding e apresentações institucionais/comerciais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Criar e desenvolver designs gráficos para uma variedade de plataformas digitais e impressas.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de marketing para garantir a coerência da marca em todas as campanhas e social media.
  • Desenvolver apresentações visuais atraentes para propostas comerciais e reuniões institucionais.
  • Gerenciar múltiplos projetos de design simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.


Requisitos:

  • Adobe Illustrator e Adobe Photoshop.
  • Conhecimento em Adobe InDesign será considerado um diferencial.
  • Portfólio comprovado.
  • Capacidade de comunicar-se claramente e eficientemente, com autonomia para trabalhar remotamente.
  • Forte habilidade de organização e gestão do tempo.

title: Video Editor
description:
Who we are:


Selfless Ventures is a private equity firm pioneering innovation across Commercial Real Estate Services, CPG, and Robotics. Our portfolio companies provide services and products to major clients such as Tesla, Target, Tonino Lamborghini, Costco, Ulta Beauty, and Keurig Dr Pepper. We focus on fostering groundbreaking initiatives that drive success and growth for our clients and partners.



We do not look for resumes - we only look for responses - fill this out:



We’re hiring 2–3 video editors who are:


  • Proficient in CapCut (desktop version preferred)
  • Able to edit cinematic, engaging short-form clips for platforms like TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Have a portfolio of prior edited clips
  • Own a computer that can handle smooth editing (minimum specs below)
  • Reliable, responsive, and deadline-focused



 Required Skills & Experience:


  • Must have edited short-form content before (examples required)
  • Strong grasp of cinematic storytelling, pacing, and transitions
  • CapCut editing proficiency — not just mobile, but full desktop workflows
  • Knows how to use effects, sound design, text animations, and color grading
  • Attention to detail + ability to follow brand voice and vision



️ Minimum Technical Requirements:


  • High-performance computer (i7 or M1/M2 chip or higher)
  • 16GB RAM minimum
  • Fast internet for file transfers
  • Experience using Google Drive, Dropbox, or Frame.io

title: Desenvolvedor Júnior (Microsoft Power Platform)
description:
Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo nas áreas de tecnologia, desenvolvimento ou afins;
  • Inglês Básico.


Habilidades Técnicas

  • Power BI, Power Automate e Power App;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software Web e banco de dados;
  • Experiência em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Habilidades em Python, JavaScript, React, html5, CSS3, construção de API e microserviços;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Programação de testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando Power BI / Power Platform, bem como as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS .


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Modelagem de dados e estatística.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com as áreas de negócio na identificação dos requisitos, design e implantação da solução;
  • Criar fluxos automatizados entre aplicações e serviços utilizando o Microsoft Power Platform: Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate e Power Pages;
  • Desenvolver e manter Dashboards no Microsoft Power BI;
  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Data Architect
description:
Job Title: Data Architect

Duration: 6months

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Need to support PST timings


Description:

What You’ll Do

Design & Strategy: Develop and maintain the overall data architecture aligned with organizational strategy.

Blueprint Creation: Create conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support data storage, processing, and consumption needs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.

Governance & Security: Define and enforce data governance, data quality, and security standards across all data systems.

Technology Selection: Evaluate and select cloud platforms, storage solutions, and data processing tools appropriate for enterprise needs.

Implementation Leadership: Oversee the delivery of data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes, and APIs.

Performance Optimization: Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability across all data systems.


Key Skills

  • Modern Data Modelling: Expertise with dbt modelling approaches and Snowflake‑optimized schemas (e.g., Star Schema, Data Vault).
  • Snowflake Architecture: Strong knowledge of virtual warehouses, scaling, clustering, and storage optimization.
  • Airflow Orchestration: Ability to design and manage complex Airflow DAGs.
  • Advanced SQL & Python: Expertise in transforming, processing, and orchestrating data.
  • AWS Infrastructure: Hands‑on experience with S3, IAM, and Private Link for secure and efficient data access.
  • ELT Strategy: Skilled in building ELT pipelines using tools like Fivetran and dbt.


Preferred Skills

  • Active Metadata & Governance (Atlan)
  • BI Semantic Layering
  • Data Mesh & Data Contracts
  • FinOps & Cost Governance
  • CI/CD for Data Pipelines

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 8+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Senior Product Designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: Consultor SAP SRM/MM
description:
A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma Pessoa Consultora SAP SRM/MM para atuar em projetos e sustentação, com foco em processos de compras, melhorias contínuas e atendimento de chamados. A atuação será em ambiente remoto, com desafios técnicos e funcionais em um contexto corporativo.


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office

Contratação: CLT

Prazo: Indeterminado

Horário: Comercial


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar no suporte e atendimento de chamados relacionados aos módulos SAP SRM e SAP MM .
  • Realizar configurações (customizing) de acordo com os processos de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias funcionais e técnicas .
  • Realizar dimensionamento de esforço para demandas e projetos.
  • Atuar com WEBDYNPRO , WORKFLOW de aprovação e ABAP para DEBUG quando necessário.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na otimização de processos e soluções SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SRM .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP MM .
  • Conhecimento de processos de compras: gestão de contratos, cotações e pedidos de compra .
  • Experiência com configurações nos módulos.
  • Atuação com atendimento de chamados e implementação de melhorias .
  • Conhecimento funcional em WEBDYNPRO .
  • Conhecimento em WORKFLOW de aprovação .
  • Conhecimento em ABAP para DEBUG .
  • Graduação completa .


Diferencial:

  • Conhecimento em RM .


O que oferecemos:


✓ Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

✓ Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos

✓ Plano odontológico

✓ Programa de remuneração variável

✓ Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade

✓ Wellhub (Gympass)

✓ Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos

✓ Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional

✓ Seguro de vida

✓ Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa)

✓ Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

✓ Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas)

✓ Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

✓ Programa de treinamentos internos e externos

✓ Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

✓ Terapia online

✓ Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges)

✓ Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro

✓ Day off no seu aniversário

✓ Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

✓ Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna)

✓ Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa)

✓ Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento)


Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Por isso, independentemente da sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, cidadania ou qualquer outro aspecto que o torne único, inscreva-se!

Sobre a MV

Somos a 3ª maior empresa de TI do Brasil. Apoiamos organizações de Saúde desde a estruturação da gestão até a construção da cultura de inovação. Com a missão de tornar o segmento mais eficiente e digital, a MV sempre contribuiu com o avanço da Saúde Digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras que mudaram o cenário de centenas de instituições.


Nosso Jeito de Ser

Compartilhados por todas as nossas áreas de negócio e em todas as regiões onde atuamos, o “Nosso Jeito de Ser” nos leva a uma cultura de alta performance, atingida pelo engajamento das pessoas. Essa estratégia detalhada é a alma da nossa instituição e deve ser uma fonte permanente de orientação e inspiração em todas as decisões institucionais.


VAGA 100% PRESENCIAL

Conduzir processos de desenvolvimento de líderes, performance de times, engajamento e transformação organizacional específicos para ambientes de tecnologia, com sensibilidade às dinâmicas e maturidade dos times.


O que esperamos de você:

Vivência como omo Business Partner, especialista em apoiar áreas de Tecnologia;

Possuir visão estratégica de negócio, capacidade de atuar como consultora interna e influência direta na tomada de decisão;

Experiência sólida em gestão de talentos, desenvolvimento de lideranças, pipelines de sucessão e programas de alta performance;

Domínio de metodologias ágeis aplicadas ao RH, trabalhando de forma integrada com squads e times multidisciplinares;

Aplicar IA no dia a dia, Posicionamento Executivo e Influência, Capacidade Analítica e Tomada de Decisão, Mediação e Gestão de Conflitos e Orientação para Resultados.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:
Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A



Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. For one of our clients , a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A .


About the Role


This is a hands-on FP&A role in a flat organization. While the right candidate may have a direct report in the future, this position requires a strong individual contributor who is comfortable owning analyses end to end.

We are looking for someone who is detail-oriented, highly analytical, and action-driven , with the ability to influence business decisions through financial insights.


Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to improve revenue, margins, and overall P&L performance

Support PE-related reporting and ad-hoc analyses

  • Help establish and improve FP&A best-practice processes in an evolving environment



Required Experience & Skills


5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment

Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus

Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling

Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)

Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives

  • Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus
  • Tableau experience is a plus, but not required
  • Private Equity experience is highly preferred



What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

  • Strong bias for action , with a proven ability to challenge the status quo using data

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Kajabi Specialist
description:
What You’ll Do

Build & Maintain Kajabi Systems

  • Build courses, lessons, modules, quizzes, and dashboards
  • Translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect Kajabi pages
  • Create responsive, premium front-end pages and student portals
  • Manage offers, checkout logic, bundles, upsells, and funnels


Automations & Tagging Architecture

  • Build advanced tagging logic for cohorts, tracks, and programs
  • Manage segmentation and timed access rules
  • Ensure flawless execution of all automations & workflows
  • Set up Zapier and platform integrations


Full QA & Technical Testing

  • Test all funnels, pages, automations, and purchase journeys
  • Catch and fix issues before launch
  • Provide QA reports and optimize user flows
  • Maintain 100% consistency, clarity, and functionality


UI/UX Execution

  • Ensure Western-standard premium layout, spacing, typography
  • Maintain visual cohesiveness across all digital assets
  • Optimize mobile, tablet, and desktop experiences
  • Support designers + marketing with clean implementation


Operations & Support

  • Build orientation pages, resource hubs, dashboards
  • Manage student access, cohorts, and track progression
  • Maintain naming systems, file structures, and internal logic
  • Ensure instructors have correct access and materials



What You Bring

  • Deep Kajabi mastery (portfolio REQUIRED)
  • Strong UI/UX psychology understanding
  • Figma → Kajabi implementation skills
  • HTML/CSS for custom Kajabi modifications
  • Advanced tagging, automation, and funnel-building skills
  • Experience with Zapier and integrations
  • Obsessive attention to detail + QA mindset
  • Strong English communication
  • Fast, independent, and organized


Bonus:

  • EdTech or youth-education experience
  • Multi-cohort / multi-track course experience
  • Familiar with 54-week programs or long-form curriculum architecture


Who You Are

  • You are the person who ensures the system NEVER breaks.
  • You think ahead, test everything, fix issues before anyone sees them, and deliver a clean, premium experience that students and instructors trust.
  • If you love owning the tech stack, building smooth user journeys, and operating at a high standard — this role is for you.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA
description:
Quer crescer junto com uma empresa que está transformando a educação com tecnologia e IA?


Se você gosta de desenvolver aplicações modernas, tem curiosidade por Inteligência Artificial, e quer trabalhar em um time que está criando agentes de IA e soluções inteligentes no Azure, essa vaga pode ser para você!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack IA para fortalecer nossa nova área de AI Solutions e ajudar a construir soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, automações e integrações inteligentes.


Como será a sua contribuição no time:


  • Desenvolver agentes de IA, aplicações e APIs com foco em IA Generativa (agentes conversacionais, análise de sentimentos, tradução, sumarização, automações).
  • Implementar lógica e fluxos de agentes de IA, ajustando prompts e comportamentos conforme diferentes cenários de uso.
  • Integrar modelos de IA (LLMs) às aplicações utilizando APIs, SDKs e bibliotecas especializadas.
  • Construir e manter microsserviços escaláveis, com atenção à performance e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar o monitoramento e a evolução das soluções de IA em produção, garantindo estabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com áreas de produto, engenharia e IA, participando ativamente das decisões técnicas.


Se você… já tem experiência como desenvolvedor(a) full stack, curiosidade por IA e vontade de aprender e crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e inovador — essa oportunidade pode ser sua!


Requisitos mínimos:


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend (React ou Vue, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend (Node.js e/ou Python).
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Experiência ou forte interesse em integração com serviços de IA/LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).
  • Criação e otimização de prompts para agentes de IA.
  • Conhecimento em Git para versionamento de código (Azure DevOps ou GitHub).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados e serviços como:
  • Azure SQL e Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage, Realtime)


Diferenciais que contam pontos:


  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework ou similares.
  • Vivência com Azure Functions, arquitetura serverless ou integrações com APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Redis para cache ou filas.
  • Interesse ou experiência com Azure AI Foundry.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Vibe Coding), utilizando ferramentas como: GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, Claude Code, etc..
  • Ter atuado em startups ou empresas de tecnologia.


O que você vai encontrar aqui:


  • Um ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado contínuo.
  • Projetos reais com IA aplicada a problemas do dia a dia.
  • Stack moderna e liberdade para experimentar e evoluir.
  • Participação direta na construção de uma nova área estratégica da empresa.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento técnico e profissional.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Description :

We are hiring a full-time Salesforce Developer to support a fast-moving merchant cash advance company. This role is focused on fixing, optimizing, and improving the Salesforce environment the sales team uses every day. You will handle UI updates, system configuration, integrations, and fast-turnaround fixes that directly impact how quickly deals move through the pipeline. Full-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Hours: 9am–5pm EST.

Salary: $4,000/mo


Key Responsibilities:

• Own Salesforce configuration: fields, formulas, layouts, list views, role hierarchy, and sharing settings

• Set up and maintain integrations — especially telephony tools like RingCentral inside Salesforce

• Improve UI and usability for reps, ensuring workflows are clear and easy to follow

• Build small Lightning components or UI enhancements when needed

• Troubleshoot and fix Lightning integration issues, permission problems, and visibility restrictions

• Adjust and maintain workflow automation (Flow, processes, rules) to support the sales process

• Update dashboards, create filtered list views, and improve record access structure

• Build and refine CRM actions such as the “Next Opportunity” button and other quick actions

• Handle fast-turnaround tasks when urgent fixes are needed (same-day or <30 minutes when possible)

• Clean up confusing configurations, inconsistent UI, or broken logic

• Document changes and communicate clearly with leadership about what was done and why


Key Qualifications:

• 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience

• Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud

• Experience with Lightning UI (components, layouts, actions, navigation)

• Ability to diagnose and fix permission issues, sharing rules, and record visibility

• Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)

• Strong grasp of Salesforce automation: Flows, process automations, workflow rules

• Able to move quickly, prioritize urgent fixes, and troubleshoot without hand-holding

• Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy

• Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet

• Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

• Experience working with merchant cash advance companies

• Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization

• Ability to advise on long-term Salesforce structure, not just fix short-term issues

title: ESPECIALISTA EM DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE (IoT & Event Streaming) | Remoto
description:
Sobre a Localiza | Mobi7

A Mobi7 é a unidade de soluções de telemetria e IoT da Localiza, líder em mobilidade na América Latina. Nossa missão é transformar dados em inteligência para veículos conectados, com tecnologia de ponta e alta performance.


Estamos buscando um(a) Especialista em Desenvolvimento de Software para atuar no desenvolvimento de microserviços event-driven de alta performance , processando dados em tempo real de dispositivos IoT instalados em veículos. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções escaláveis, resilientes e observáveis, usando uma stack moderna e práticas avançadas de engenharia.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver microserviços event-driven com Java 21+ , Spring Boot 3.5+ e Spring Cloud Stream .
  • Implementar pipelines de streaming de eventos com Apache Kafka (MSK), garantindo Exactly-Once Semantics , DLQ e particionamento eficiente.
  • Criar e evoluir contratos de dados com Avro e Schema Registry .
  • Otimizar persistência em PostgreSQL e cache distribuído com Redis .
  • Garantir observabilidade avançada com Datadog APM , logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Atuar em ambiente AWS (ECS Fargate, MSK, CloudWatch) com práticas DevOps e CI/CD.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida atuando com Java (Spring Boot).
  • Domínio avançado de Apache Kafka .
  • Experiência com AWS (ECS, Parameter Store, CloudWatch).
  • Proficiência em testes automatizados (JUnit, Testcontainers).


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com Kotlin 2.x .
  • Conhecimento em Datadog APM , Avro , Liquibase .
  • Familiaridade com GraalVM Native Image .


Diferenciais:

  • Projetos open-source.
  • Certificação AWS.
  • Experiência com IoT/telemetria veicular.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO:

  • Participação nos Lucros;
  • Carro Corporativo;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Reembolso de Despesas Médicas;
  • Wellhub;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Allya;
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza;
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos.


Viva a experiência de ser Localiza&Co e venha construir o futuro da mobilidade conosco!

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python + JavaScript)
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Engineer (Python + JavaScript)

No Working Machines will be provided


Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on coding experience in:
  • Python
  • JavaScript / Node.js
  • TypeScript
  • Solid experience with Linux, Bash scripting, and automation
  • Strong knowledge of Docker and reproducible development environments
  • Advanced Git skills (branching, diffs, patches, conflict resolution)

  • PhD in a technical field with 2+ years of experience

title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (LATAM Only)
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

Location: Remote — Brazil/US time zones (EST ±3h) • Contract: International contractor, $35/hour • Language: English (fluent) • Reports to: CTO & Engineering team.



About the role

Volatus is hiring a Senior Fullstack Engineer to own critical product work on a next‑generation platform for fertility clinics and their patients. You will join as a founding engineer, shaping both the product and the technical direction in a category where better software directly improves patient outcomes.


Tech context

You will work in a modern, greenfield stack centered on:

  • Frontend: Next.js/React , Typescript , Tailwind CSS
  • Backend: Node.js/TypeScript with a PostgreSQL core (schema design, authN,authZ, performance, transactions, triggers).
  • Data & integrations: Third-party API integrations ; performance profiling (e.g., Lighthouse).
  • Quality: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; CI/CD .
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our Head of Engineering, Principal Engineer, Product Designer, and CEO.


What you will do

  • Build and ship end‑to‑end features across the Next.js frontend and Node/TypeScript backend. 
  • Model and tune Postgres schemas; ensure secure authN/authZ and strong performance. 
  • Integrate external APIs and improve app reliability and speed (including Lighthouse‑driven improvements). 
  • Write reliable tests (unit/integration/e2e) and contribute to CI/CD workflows. 
  • Make pragmatic early‑stage architectural decisions and raise the engineering bar.


What you will bring

  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate development and quality. 
  • Strong production experience with Next.js/React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Tailwind & CSS mastery; responsive, accessible UI. 
  • PostgreSQL expertise (modeling, security/auth, performance, transactions, triggers). 
  • Integrations experience (third‑party APIs) and solid testing practice (unit/integration/e2e). 
  • Portfolio or links to shipped projects/code.


90-day outcomes

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Lead at least one significant feature from design to production, used by real clinics or internal teams.​
  • Improve a key part of the frontend experience (e.g., performance, usability, or design consistency) and document the standards for others.​
  • Own part of the backend or data model, including at least one meaningful performance or reliability improvement.​
  • Help define or refine testing and deployment practices so the team can ship faster and with more confidence.


Nice to have

  • Experience building voice‑controlled components / speech‑to‑text. 
  • Experience interacting with AI models from the web app.


How we work

  • Remote within EST ±3 hours preferred ; open to other time zones if you can collaborate on US‑friendly hours.
  • Small, senior team with a strong bias toward action and ownership ;
  • Product-led culture : engineers are closely involved in discovery, tradeoff discussions, and shaping the roadmap.


Hiring process

  • Coderpad Challenge (60 min)
  • Intro chat (45 min) – mutual fit and role context.
  • Technical deep‑dive & Live testing – discuss systems you’ve built; pair on a focused problem (no whiteboard trivia).
  • Team conversation – meet engineering + product leadership.
  • References & offer.


Volatus is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Na Printi, acreditamos que cada detalhe faz a diferença, mas o que realmente importa é você, independente de sua origem, identidade ou crenças!


Somos uma empresa composta por um time diverso e inclusivo de pessoas #Printers, sempre prontas para transformar ideias em realidade gráfica. Valorizamos a pluralidade e buscamos proporcionar soluções para negócios de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, atendendo de pequenos empreendedores a grandes corporações.


Desde 2012, atuamos no mercado brasileiro com o investimento e a expertise do grupo Cimpress, líder global em customização em massa. Com um portfólio extenso, tecnologia de ponta, preços competitivos e prazos rápidos, oferecemos mais do que produtos: oferecemos confiança, respeito e parcerias duradouras.


Venha fazer parte dessa história de sucesso e inovação, com um ambiente de trabalho e soluções que celebram a diversidade e promovem a igualdade. A Printi é grande e, com você, seremos ainda maiores!


Responsabilidades :


  • Atuar como referência técnica da squad, orientando o time na definição de soluções, revisão de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir o andamento das entregas técnicas, organizando prioridades com o time e acompanhando o progresso junto ao PM, antecipando riscos e removendo impedimentos.
  • Colaborar com PMs, Designers e QAs desde a concepção, ajudando a transformar objetivos de produto em decisões técnicas viáveis, claras e sustentáveis.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico do time, apoiando na mentoria de pessoas desenvolvedoras e fortalecendo a autonomia e consistência da squad.
  • Garantir visibilidade e organização do trabalho técnico, mantendo a documentação essencial e promovendo o compartilhamento de conhecimento.
  • Propor e acompanhar melhorias contínuas de arquitetura, ferramentas e processos que aumentem a qualidade, estabilidade e eficiência do time.


Requisitos :


  • Formação superior em Ciências da Computação, Sistema de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como Tech Lead.
  • Vivência em times orientados a produto


Benefícios :


  • Plano médico e odontológico Amil para cuidar de você e sua família;
  • Vale alimentação/refeição, disponibilizado num cartão flexível;
  • Auxilio Home Office;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário, para celebrar seu dia especial como merece;
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Total pass, para garantir um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado, para você e seus dependentes;
  • Vittude: 40% de desconto em sessões de psicoterapia online;
  • Desconto de 20% nos produtos da Printi para você aproveitar.

title: Gerente de Projeto (Project Manager)
description:
RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Planejar, executar e acompanhar projetos de produto e tecnologia, garantindo prazos, escopo e qualidade
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre stakeholders, times de desenvolvimento, produto e liderança
  • Definir cronogramas, ritos, indicadores e relatórios de acompanhamento
  • Identificar riscos, propor soluções e apoiar a tomada de decisão
  • Garantir alinhamento estratégico entre objetivos do negócio e entregas do time
  • Apoiar a evolução dos processos de gestão de projetos em ambiente de startup


REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos em ambiente de tecnologia ou produto digital
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Agile híbrido)
  • Capacidade de organização, comunicação e negociação
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e orientado a resultados
  • Experiência em startups ou empresas de tecnologia será um diferencial

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Certificações em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, etc.)
  • Experiência com produtos SaaS ou plataformas digitais
  • Atuação próxima a times de desenvolvimento (tech background)

O QUE OFERECEMOS:

  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante crescimento;
  • Autonomia para propor melhorias e estruturar processos;
  • Contato direto com liderança e impacto real no produto;
  • Modelo de contratação CLT;
  • Vale Refeição ou Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte: é concedido ao colaborador, para uso no trajeto residência – trabalho – residência sem desconto mensal;
  • Wellhub: benefício de bem-estar que ajuda você e seus dependentes legais a cuidar da saúde física e mental, com acesso a uma rede de academias, aulas online, terapia, nutricionistas e muito mais;
  • Starben.

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator


About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.


About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Pré-vendas (SDR)
description:
Link de inscrição:


A Go Beesiness é uma startup de impacto social que utiliza tecnologia e inteligência artificial para transformar o recrutamento e a empregabilidade no Brasil. Somos criadores da Go Bee Jobs, plataforma que conecta talentos diversos a empresas inclusivas, promovendo diversidade, inovação e eficiência nos processos de contratação.


Aqui, acreditamos que o sucesso nasce do trabalho em equipe, da criatividade e da coragem de aprender. Se você quer voar junto com a gente e fazer parte de um ambiente onde ideias ganham asas, este é o seu lugar!


Agora, estamos em busca de um(a) SDR (Sales Development Representative) para reforçar nosso time comercial e ajudar a expandir nossa missão: transformar vidas por meio da educação, inclusão e tecnologia. Esta é uma atividade de pré-venda. Posição muito importante em uma estrutura comercial moderna.


Suas responsabilidades serão:


- Realizar a prospecção ativa de leads (B2B e B2G), qualificando potenciais clientes.

- Pesquisar e identificar oportunidades em empresas e instituições alinhadas à nossa proposta de valor.

- Conduzir o primeiro contato com decisores de RH, tecnologia e gestão.

- Gerar interesse pela solução e agendar reuniões para o time de vendas.

- Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing e Vendas para otimizar funil e conversões.


O que esperamos:


- Energia, proatividade, vontade real de crescer em vendas e que seja focado em resultados financeiros.

- Boa comunicação e clareza ao se expressar

- Disciplina para rotina de contatos e follow-ups

- Vontade de aprender (experiência prévia como SDR é diferencial, não obrigação)


Modelo de trabalho:


- Remoto

- Regime PJ

- Remuneração com fixo + variável

- Horário de trabalho flexível 


Nosso Jeito de Ser


Na Go Beesiness, somos movidos por seis valores fundamentais: colaboração, inovação, impacto social, diversidade, simplicidade e antifragilidade.


  • Queremos pessoas que enxerguem o aprendizado como combustível, e a criatividade como ferramenta de transformação.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.
